cases.title: Six Juggernaut supporting packages
cases.subject: traits
cases.original_question: Is six Juggernaut really as flexible as people say, or do the Hunter/Primal and Summoner versions perform differently?
cases.question: Is six Juggernaut really as flexible as people say, or do the Hunter/Primal and Summoner versions perform differently?
cases.scenario: Exactly six recorded Juggernaut contributors in the primary slice; inspect Hunter/Primal, Summoner and overlapping support packages with declared itemized carry roles.
cases.plan: Use the named Juggernaut contribution condition, discover actual carry pairs and support, then verify both joint package traits and unit conjunctions. compare_cohorts compares explicit package cells, keeping intersections separate and stratifying named carry/tank stars and loadouts.
cases.checks: Report counts, recurrence and mean/top4/win for each package, not a single six-Juggernaut marginal. Preserve AP/AD item differences, named Gunblade holders and Maokai presence rather than assuming equal equipment from the trait count.
cases.limits: Exactly six contributors is a deliberately narrower definition than all boards in a six-activation breakpoint band; report a broader band separately if used. Generic role, total-board budget and automatic family discovery remain unsupported.

cases.title: Eclipse interaction across carry families
cases.subject: traits
cases.original_question: Does Eclipse perform differently on upgraded Solar boards built around Kayle than on Lunar boards built around Aphelios?
cases.question: Does Eclipse perform differently on upgraded Solar boards built around Kayle than on Lunar boards built around Aphelios?
cases.scenario: Itemized Kayle/Solar and itemized Aphelios/Lunar families defined independently of Eclipse; dual-itemized boards separate, with explicit Solar-member upgrade vectors.
cases.plan: Within each family/star vector, compare active Eclipse against its complement in the shared shell, so missing trait rows are included in the without-active group. Query recorded Solar/Lunar support and verify named three-star contributors. Contrast the resulting within-family estimates descriptively.
cases.checks: Report all family-by-Eclipse cells with upgrade definitions, samples and outcomes before claiming an interaction. Do not use a single pooled Eclipse average or silently assign dual-carry boards to both independent groups.
cases.limits: No global unique-three-star-count filter or native interaction confidence interval. Named upgrade vectors are supported; exhaustive upgrade-depth strata and Lux choice require preparation/observable identity.

cases.title: Mama Beak carry versus trait passenger
cases.subject: traits
cases.original_question: When Mama Beak is actually the carry, do three-Summoner boards with a small Riftbeast package outperform the vertical Riftbeast versions?
cases.question: When Mama Beak is actually the carry, do three-Summoner boards with a small Riftbeast package outperform the vertical Riftbeast versions?
cases.scenario: Mama Beak has at least two explicitly offensive completed items, three-item sensitivity, exact stars retained; compare three Summoner/three Riftbeast with higher Riftbeast support, preserving hybrids.
cases.plan: Discover named offensive loadouts to operationalize carry investment, then define joint Summoner/Riftbeast contribution cohorts rather than mutually exclusive guide labels. Compare packages in shared stars/levels/named frontline and secondary-carry conditions; inspect deployed-unit and item-count distributions.
cases.checks: Show qualifying item builds, cell counts and mean/top4/win; distinguish unitemized Mama Beak from the carry population. Keep hybrid higher-Riftbeast+Summoner groups explicit. This tests support packages, not Titan's versus Kraken.
cases.limits: No generic offensive-item predicate, exact-board-size matching or Alpha Mark ownership. Exact role taxonomy is a declared candidate-build choice, not combat damage evidence.

cases.title: Azir and Zyra support-package tradeoff
cases.subject: traits
cases.original_question: On boards carrying Azir and Zyra together, is the Blackthorn/Brawler package worth more than keeping Juggernaut frontline and extra Executioner support?
cases.question: On boards carrying Azir and Zyra together, is the Blackthorn/Brawler package worth more than keeping Juggernaut frontline and extra Executioner support?
cases.scenario: Azir and Zyra each hold at least two declared offensive completed items, stars separated; Blackthorn/Brawler versus Juggernaut/extra-Executioner supporting packages, with hybrids retained.
cases.plan: Use exact named item/loadout evidence to establish both carry proxies, discover supporting unit conjunctions and recorded trait contributions, and compare explicit packages at shared level/star/investment conditions. Inspect Summoner support and extra carry/tank items through grouped cohort tables.
cases.checks: Both carries must be itemized in the queried population. Report package recurrence, counts and placement/top4/win with overlap and actual supporting-unit changes. Do not treat coexisting Blackthorn/Juggernaut/Executioner traits as exclusive without checking.
cases.limits: No offensive-role field, total-board budget filter, sacrifice identity, summon contribution or tanking output. Observed support-package association is the benchmark, not a causal explanation of Blackthorn benefits.
